inspection: D4–D6.4 outcomes and the source-only minimum/maximum and <=5 weak-degree counts were inspected. Choices below are fixed before D6.5 comparative fitting; this is not blinded preregistration.
selection: Every anatomical node is a root. Include the root and all nodes reached within the declared number of hops, ignoring direction only for weak variants; retain every induced directed chemical edge. Never truncate, sample or choose by response or model score. D2 common Ollivier/flow preparation gates apply unchanged.
degree: Number of distinct adjacent nodes in the full parent chemical graph, union of incoming and outgoing neighbors; a reciprocal pair counts once. Also retain directed in/out degree. Low degree means <=5, including isolated nodes. DREAM4 identities and degrees are network-local.
coverage: Separate parent membership, exact mapped recording columns, exact stimulated events, uncontaminated time windows before scope gating, common-provider preparation, representation in any prepared scope, and original response-pair/group eligibility. Dataset8 target eligibility remains candidate coverage only: its D6.2 primary is unavailable. Preparation is not successful numerical execution.
comparisonPopulation: Dataset7 only: intersect each alternative prepared rooted scope with the original 60 eligible D5 pairs. Retain every pair in a selection ledger. Require >=3 common receivers and >=2 distinct magnitudes per source, then >=5 source groups. Rerank only this explicitly new matched population. No new signal extraction, receiver substitution, expanded native target population or anatomy pooling. DREAM4 full-network coverage is a control, not a rooted-scope experiment.
computationGate: For each available matched population, every target-bearing alternative scope must complete; one declared numerical limit invalidates the entire comparison, not just that root. Other roots remain an exhaustive preparation-only census. This separate target-bearing gate does not replace D5/D6.2's complete prepared-scope gate or repair Dataset8.
fitting: Refit all four D3 weighted nested whole-source ridge models in both reference and alternative contexts on exactly the same matched targets. B23, Q31 placeholder basis, S31 graph controls and G31 use D6.3 definitions, recomputed on the declared graph. Unit-half D6.4 geometry wrapper is reused with its exact metadata. Q is not fitted. Reference geometry/features are authenticated D6.3 evidence. No settings selected by outcomes.
aggregation: Equal source-group means, exact rational rank-skill differences and descriptive group/leave-one-group-out ranges; no IID pair inference, p-values or winner selection. Different alternative intersections cannot be ranked as if they were one population.
independent: Python independently reconstructs all selections, boundaries, parent degrees, degree-bin counts, metadata observation coverage and matched populations; all newly successful geometry uses the pinned D6.4 NetworkX reference, exact S features and independent joint-intercept ridge. Runtime replay retains failed computations; independent success verification does not certify the runtime rational digit limit. Original source extraction and measurements reuse hash-bound D4/D5/D6.2 evidence.
